$$
(a + b)\left(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}\right) = \frac{a + b}{a} + \frac{a + b}{b} = 2 + \frac{b}{a} + \frac{a}{b}

$$
\frac{\frac{a}{b} + \frac{b}{a}}{2} \geq \sqrt{\frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{b}{a}} = \sqrt{1} = 1

\frac{a}{b} + \frac{b}{a} \geq 2
$$

$$
(a + b)\left(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}\right) = 2 + \frac{a}{b} + \frac{b}{a} \geq 2 + 2 = 4
